[ISBK.3.5] **The seven backends.** Each backing's static aggregation set
([ISBK.3.2]), and the optional entry points its backend carries ([ISBK.1.5],
[ISBK.1.6], [ISBK.1.8]). Every one carries `instance_clone` ([ISBK.1.9]). Names
and versions are [NDET.2.5]'s.

| Backing | Static aggregation set | `evict_stale` | `query_with_value` | `query_at` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` | avg, stdev, pstdev, variance, pvariance, min, max, rate, direction, count, sum, first, last, bool_and, bool_or | | | |
| `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` | the Welford set, and median, count_distinct, count_of, contains, percentile, onset_rate | yes | yes | yes |
| `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` | min, max | yes | | |
| `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` | first, last, bool_and, bool_or | yes | | |
| `SeriesBackendReservoir` | avg, stdev, pstdev, variance, pvariance, min, max, sum, count, median, percentile, bool_and, bool_or | | yes | |
| `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` | active_fraction | | | yes |
| `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral` | integral | | | yes |

A static set bounds what a backend may serve. Which backing serves each
aggregation in a program is [LSER.18.1]'s and [LSIG.1.1]'s.
